title: Exact Symmetry-Stratified Search for Fast Matrix Multiplication over F2: A Second Inequivalent Rank-47 Scheme for 4x4, Rigidity Theorems, and Large Same-Rank Families at 5x5 and 6x6
description:
An exact, symmetry-stratified computational search for bilinear matrix-multiplication schemes over the field with two elements, run on a single consumer laptop. Every scheme is accepted only after a direct check of all n^6 Brent equations, and every negative result is a solver refutation rather than an exhausted budget.

Results. (1) The rank-47 <4,4,4> factorization published by AlphaTensor is exactly invariant under a group of order 12, an S3 of permutation sandwiches together with a transpose-swap involution, with orbit sizes 12,6,6,6,6,3,3,3,1,1. (2) Searching from scratch under that symmetry produced a second, host-verified rank-47 scheme for 4x4 over F2 that shares no term with AlphaTensor's, has a different GL(4,2)^3-invariant factor-rank signature, and is therefore inequivalent to it under every change of basis and slot symmetry. (3) Both rank-47 schemes are locally rigid and flip-isolated, established by 28,835 decided SAT instances. (4) A fixed-point restriction lemma for involution-symmetric schemes refutes symmetry classes at negligible cost and re-derives rank_F2<2,2,2> = 7 by SAT. (5) At 5x5 and 6x6 the published rank-93 and rank-153 schemes sit in families of 307 and 79 distinct host-verified same-rank schemes, where one of each was previously known.

Scope. No published record is improved, and whether a rank-46 scheme for 4x4 over F2 exists remains open. Every refutation is exact but conditional on a symmetry assumption and local to a stated rewrite radius; Section 12 of the paper states the scope of each class of result precisely.

Contents. The paper and its supplement with LaTeX sources, seven figures, the search and verification code, and the evidence: every host-verified scheme, one JSON record per SAT instance for every campaign, DRAT certificates for a sample of refutations, and the frozen state of two censuses that are enumerated and resumable. A fresh clone reproduces all 21 checks of the reproduction script, regenerates all seven figures byte-identically, and rebuilds both PDFs.
notes: Computations were performed on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU and 12 CPU cores, using CaDiCaL 1.9.5 through PySAT. The per-instance logs account for 352.9 solver-hours over 311,872 instance records. Two categories of intermediate data are deliberately omitted: solver stdout and stderr, which are process output rather than results, and the bulk flip-graph walker pools, which the papers and the *_dissection.json digests summarise.
